description: Verifier probe set (M0.8c). Each source is a sentence taken from the ingested canada.ca text; each claim is labelled supported (the source states it) or not (changed number, condition or group, or about something the source does not mention). Used by scripts/probe_structured.py --roles verifier.

sources.work_hours: Full-time students may work off campus up to 24 hours per week while classes are in session. During scheduled breaks, such as the winter holidays or summer break, they may work full-time.
sources.work_start: You can't work before your studies begin.
sources.work_sin: You must have a social insurance number (SIN) to work in Canada.
sources.funds_table: From September 1, 2026, a single applicant must show $23,448 for living expenses. A family of 2 must show $29,192 and a family of 3 must show $35,888.
sources.gic: You can show proof of funds with a guaranteed investment certificate from a Canadian financial institution.
sources.biometrics_exempt: Children under 14 and applicants over 79 do not need to give biometrics for a temporary residence application.
sources.biometrics_fee: The biometrics fee is CAN$85 for an individual applicant. Families applying at the same time pay a maximum total fee of CAN$170.
sources.pgwp_min: You must complete a program of study at a PGWP-eligible designated learning institution that was at least 8 months long.
sources.pgwp_window: You must apply for your PGWP within 180 days of confirmation that you completed your program of study.
sources.pgwp_field: There are no field of study requirements for graduates with a bachelor's degree, master's degree or doctoral degree.
sources.pal_exempt: Master's and doctoral students at a public designated learning institution do not need a provincial or territorial attestation letter for applications received on or after January 1, 2026.
sources.language_age: Your language test results must be less than 2 years old when you apply.
sources.ielts_version: For Express Entry, you must take the IELTS General Training option.
sources.fsw_experience: Your work experience must be at least 1 year of continuous work or 1,560 hours total, which is 30 hours per week.
sources.fsw_quebec: You must plan to live outside the province of Quebec. The province of Quebec selects its own skilled workers.
sources.visitor_validity: Generally, a visitor visa may be valid for up to a maximum of 10 years, or until the expiry of either your passport or biometrics, whichever comes first.
